item.title: An Overview of Greek Mythology: Attempting to Appreciate Art Through the Lens of Myth
item.description: From zodiac courses to travels in Greece, from the primordial Chaos to the maturation of Cupid—a non-expert's rough synthesis of the main threads of Greek mythology and the beautiful encounters between myth and art.

item.title: Learn to Self-Evaluate Instead of Slowly Criticizing Yourself
item.description: We are trained from childhood to wait for external grades, but we have never practiced self-assessment. It's not that we don't care; it's that we care too much, to the point where we are afraid to look.

item.title: The Only Scarce Resource Is Time
item.description: Reflecting on the signals sent by the body due to allergies, this piece re-examines the relationship between money and time, contemplating what the only truly scarce resource in life really is.

item.title: Reflections on Personal Yoga Practice
item.description: A summary of my years of personal yoga practice, documenting insights on breathing, stretching, and stability.

item.title: Observing the Chain Reaction of My Parents' Emotions
item.description: A reflection on understanding parental emotions, the underlying vulnerability beneath displays of anger, and learning to establish healthy emotional boundaries.

item.title: Searching for One's Own Poetry in a Fickle Fate: A Materialist's Exploration of Astrological Models
item.description: Personal psychological preparation before diving into the study of astrology.

item.title: Serbia Travel & Ski Guide: Belgrade Eats and Kopaonik Slopes
item.description: A recap of my winter trip to Serbia with my mom. Includes pre-trip preparation, sightseeing in Belgrade, and tips for skiing in Kopaonik.
